name: neartensor
description: NearTensor: create your own Bittensor-style subnets that attest NEAR chain state, with pluggable consensus (yuma, mean, winner; drop a file to add one). Runs local-first or on subtensor. Ships a whitepaper and the NEAR-side subnet contracts. All code lives in src/.

endpoints.POST /neartensor/register_validator: Register a validator on a subnet
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_subnets: List local subnets (netuid, name, consensus, tasks, neurons)
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_create: Create a subnet: name, consensus, tasks; this box's miner+validator join
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_status: Bittensor subnet status (chain, netuid, metagraph, validator scores)
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_epoch: Run one validation epoch: query miners, verify vs NEAR, set weights
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_task: Send one attestation task to the local miner
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_register: Register this box's hotkey as miner or validator
endpoints.POST /neartensor/sn_serve: Start miner + validator neurons under pm2
endpoints.POST /neartensor/register_subnet: Register a subnet by locking NEAR BlocTime-style (stake x lock_seconds >= min)
endpoints.POST /neartensor/stake_subnet: Back a subnet with a BlocTime lock (raises its eviction score)
endpoints.POST /neartensor/registration_terms: BlocTime registration terms: min, max lock, curve, eviction threshold
endpoints.POST /neartensor/quote_registration: Deposit needed to register at a given lock_seconds
